battle.name: 高麗蒙古戰爭
battle.theater: 鴨綠江流域與忠州山城前線
battle.brief: 一二三一年十月，窩闊台遣蒙軍越鴨綠江攻龜州、忠州，高麗倚山城與火缽抵禦，屢挫蒙騎；一二五八年忽必烈索取人質再整軍，終因蒙哥死於釣魚城而作罷。卡面希臘火並未入此役，它是拜占庭銅管噴火的年代卡；高麗陣上真正對應的，是填充猛火料的陶缽與可調射程的投石器。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 高麗蒙古戰爭起於一二三一年十月，斷續打到一二五九年，是蒙古帝國強迫高麗王國接受朝貢體系的連續戰役。高麗一方是朝鮮半島南部李氏王朝的王國，中央由樞密院掌軍令，三軍六衛的中樞軍駐京畿，平安、忠清、全羅三道的地方軍分守各城，州縣另有以結社為單位組織的義兵，平時為農，戰時擔任城守與游擊；軍中還有一部由僧道率領的神眾。雙方前後有過三次大規模衝突：第一次在一二三一年至一二三二年，第二次在一二三六年至一二三八年，第三次在一二五八年至一二五九年因蒙哥陣亡而流產，其間夾雜著二十餘年的零星入侵與使者往返。蒙古一方以蒙古本部騎兵為骨幹,徵發降附的漢軍、契丹、女真步卒,並自中原與西域帶來攻城工匠,裝備配重投石機、雲梯、撞木與穴地器具;其後在北方設立征東行省,以平壤為治所,以達魯花赤監臨高麗國政。第三方是金朝:蒙古要求高麗出兵助攻,高麗在一二三二年被迫與金斷絕往來,半島南北兩端同時成戰場,而南宋隔海旁觀。指揮系統上,蒙古靠大汗詔令與驛傳站赤分派各路大軍,高麗則由樞密院發令、各道兵馬使與節度使執行,義兵聽命於本州郡守將。整體而言,這是一場征服者以騎兵與攻城技術對上以山城與消耗力對抗的長期戰役,雙方都沒有速戰速決的手段。
countriesEn: The Goryeo–Mongol War opened in October 1231 and ran in stages until 1259, a series of campaigns in which the Mongol Empire forced the Kingdom of Goryeo onto a tributary footing. On the Goryeo side stood the kingdom of the Yi dynasty in the southern half of the Korean peninsula. Central command rested with the Privy Council, which issued the army orders; the central army of the Three Corps and Six Guards garrisoned the capital region, while the provincial troops of the circuits of Pyeongan, Chungcheong and Jeolla held the frontier cities. Beyond the regular forces, each county could call on the yeongbi, village militia bands organised in local associations, who were farmers in time of peace and garrison troops and raiders in time of war; a share of the army consisted of Buddhist formations led by monks and by the shinsung units. There were two main rounds of fighting, the first from 1231 to 1232 and the second from 1258 to 1259, with sporadic clashes in between across more than twenty years. The Mongol side was led by Mongol native cavalry, augmented by surrendered Han Chinese, Khitan and Jurchen foot, and by siege engineers drafted from the Chinese and Central Asian lands, who brought counterweight trebuchets, ladders, battering rams and tunnelling tools; later the Yuan established a Branch Secretariat for the East with its seat at Pyongyang and a darqachi supervising Goryeo's government. A third party was the Jin dynasty: the Mongols required Goryeo to join them in attacking Jin, and in 1232 Goryeo was forced to break off relations with the Jin, so that the peninsula fought on two fronts at once, while the Southern Song watched from across the water. In terms of command, the Mongols distributed their armies on the authority of the khagan's edicts and moved them along an imperial relay, whereas Goryeo issued its orders through the Privy Council and executed them through the provincial commanders and military governors, with the yeongbi answering to the local commandant. In sum, this was a long war in which a conqueror with cavalry and siegecraft confronted a kingdom holding out through mountain fortresses and staying power, and neither side had a means of deciding it quickly.
people: 高麗方面，一二二九年即位的忠宣王是這場戰爭最初的決策者：面對蒙古的第一次索求，他同意交付部分馬匹與布帛，卻拒絕增派大軍助攻金國，也拒絕把太子送入蒙古營中作為人質，此一先例把雙方推向長期對峙。外朝重臣崔㫕數次奉命出使蒙古營，往返皆以拖延與周旋為務，一二三八年被遣赴蒙並遭留置，直至一二四一年前後才返國，返國後反因通蒙之嫌被貶謫，成為後世爭論應否事蒙的標誌人物。僧侶道詵兩度入蒙，以佛法與文字周旋，成為高麗與蒙古之間罕見的非軍事使節。蒙古方面，一二三一年至一二三二年入軍的統帥，韓系史籍多記為忽敦、孛哥等蒙古諸王，兩人分領本部與漢軍，負責越鴨綠江與攻取龜州、忠州；一二三六年至一二三八年第二次入侵時，仍是蒙古諸王分道出擊，高麗應付的不是單一統帥，而是一整套體系。一二五八年主導最後一波準備的是忽必烈，他開列出金銀、絹帛與人質的條件，並調集兩路大軍準備東西並進；同年八月蒙哥在攻宋的釣魚城之戰中陣亡，其部將汪德臣亦死於該役，東征高麗的計畫因此全部落空。戰後元軍攻入高麗，國王恭愍王於一二七六年被俘並押往大都，成為這場戰爭最徹底的一次失敗。除此之外，雙方在二十八年間還產生大量沒有留下姓名的中下層人物：高麗的兵馬使、節度使、團練使與義兵首領，蒙古的百戶長、千戶長與隨軍工匠，正是這批人決定了每一次圍城能不能打下來。
peopleEn: The decision-maker on the Goryeo side at the opening of the war was King Chungseon, who had taken the throne in 1229. Faced with the first Mongol demands he agreed to hand over part of the horses and the silk, but he refused to commit a major army to the campaign against Jin, and he refused to deliver the crown prince to the Mongol camp as a hostage; that precedent set the pattern for two decades of friction. The minister Choe Geup served repeatedly as envoy to the Mongol camp, buying time and managing the exchanges; in 1238 he was sent to Mongolia and was held there, returning only around 1241, and once home he was demoted for his dealings with the Mongols, which made him the emblem of the later debate over whether Goryeo should serve the Mongols. The Buddhist monk Do-seon travelled to the Mongol court twice, using texts and doctrine rather than troops as his medium, and became a rare non-military emissary between the two states. On the Mongol side, the commanders of the campaigns of 1231 and 1232 are recorded in the Korean histories as Mongol princes such as Hudun and Boge, who between them held the native horse and the Chinese foot and were responsible for crossing the Yalu and taking Guju and Chungju; in the second invasion of 1236 to 1238 several Mongol princes again moved in separate columns, so that Goryeo was not facing one commander but a whole system. The man who drove the last round of preparations in 1258 was Kublai Khan, who set out the terms in gold, silver, silk and hostages and assembled two armies for a pincer in east and west; in August of that year Möngke Khan fell at Diaoyu Fortress while campaigning against Song, and his commander Wang Dechen died in the same assault, so the planned expedition against Goryeo collapsed entirely. The one outright defeat came afterwards: in 1276 the Yuan armies broke into Goryeo, the king Gongmin was taken prisoner and carried off to Dadu, and that was the most complete loss of the whole affair. Alongside the named figures stand the thousands who left no name in the records: the military governors, the provincial commanders, the drill officers and the militia leaders on the Goryeo side, and the hundreds, the thousands and the engineer standards of the Mongol host. Whether a given siege fell or held was decided by these people.
kits: 卡面的希臘火是拜占庭的虹吸式噴射器：銅管連著船首的活塞艙與油箱，點燃後把混了松脂、瀝青的燃燒劑噴出水面或城牆，用途是拒止敵人靠攏。它最著名的兩次戰役是六七八年與七一七年至七一八年的君士坦丁堡之圍，之後配方逐步外洩或失傳，九世紀以後已從軍用退成象徵，十二世紀只剩一個凶名。本役在一二三一年，距離希臘火最盛期已有五百餘年，戰場上並沒有任何銅管噴火裝置。真正同類的東西在高麗手上：火缽，即填入猛火油與易燃料的陶缽，守軍從城頭擲下或以投石器拋出，專門點燃城下的攻城器械、雲梯與密集的攻擊縱隊。蒙古方面在攻宋與攻高麗的戰役中自漢地與西域帶來投石機、霹靂砲、雲梯與穴地工匠，日後元軍的火器技術正是在這些工程裡長出來的。蒙古騎兵的基本裝備是反曲角的複合弓與鐵鏃箭，配馬刀、長矛、標槍與皮甲，馬匹以蒙古馬與北方牧群為主，補給靠氈帳、駱駝隊與驛傳站赤，沿線徵發草料與肉乾。高麗方面的兵器以弓弩、長柄刀與鐵鎬為主，城頭備有矢石砲、拒馬、鹿砦與壕溝，靠城內儲糧與海路運糧維持。總之，卡面兵器在本役的位置是譜系上的遠祖：它代表以火阻退接近者這個思路，而高麗的火缽與後來的震天雷，才是在同一條線上真正落到高麗山城頭上的東西。
kitsEn: The card's Greek fire is the Byzantine siphon projector: a copper tube linked to a piston reservoir and a fuel tank, lit to spray a burning mixture of resin and crude oil across a ship's prow or over a wall, its purpose being to keep an enemy from closing. Its two most famous appearances were at the sieges of Constantinople in 678 and again in 717 to 718; the formula then leaked or was lost, and after the ninth century the device slipped out of military service and became a symbol, and by the twelfth century it survived only as a frightening name. This war began in 1231, more than five centuries after the heyday of Greek fire, and no copper firing tube stood on any battlefield in Korea. The thing that actually filled that role lay with Goryeo: the fire pot, a ceramic jar packed with burning oil and a combustible charge, dropped from the ramparts or slung by a stone-throwing engine, set alight the siege works, the ladders and the dense columns massed below. On the other side of the front the Mongols brought counterweight trebuchets, tall siege frames, ladders and tunnelling crews out of China and Central Asia for their campaigns against Song and Goryeo, and the Yuan's own gunnery grew out of exactly those engineering works. The Mongol horse carried the composite recurved bow with iron-tipped arrows, alongside sabre, long spear, javelin and leather armour, and the mounts were Mongol horses raised on the northern pastures, fed by felt tents, camel trains and the imperial relay, with fodder and dried meat taken from the country as the columns advanced. Goryeo's own order of battle was bow and crossbow, long-handled blade and iron mace, with stone-throwing engines, cheval-de-frise, abatis and ditches dug round the walls, kept going by grain stored inside the cities and by grain shipped in by sea. The correct place of the card weapon in this war is therefore genealogical: it stands for the idea of denying close approach with fire, while the vessel that actually carried that idea onto Korean ramparts was the Goryeo fire pot and, later, the gunpowder bomb.
tactics: 蒙古軍的戰術骨架是分進合擊加逐城攻堅。他們不求一次打下整個半島，而是把兵分作數路，同時壓向幾座山城，讓高麗的守軍無法集中；每到一城，先以數千弓箭手在射程內列陣射擊，壓制城頭的弓弩手，再把配重投石機推到射程內連日轟擊，待城頭露出破綻才以雲梯、穴地與撞木同時進攻。他們也懂得用飢餓：攻不下就分兵抄掠周邊、拆毀田禾與糧秣，逼守軍在城內耗盡存糧；每到冬季，牧場的草料已不足養活數萬匹戰馬，遠征便必須在秋末之前收隊，於是攻一城、拖一冬的持久戰對蒙古不利，對守城方有利。高麗的應對正是利用這一點：全軍避免野戰，把主力搬上龜州、忠州、尙丹一帶的山城，屯糧城內，令各道義兵以結社為單位在山谷與山口游擊，切斷蒙軍的糧道與徵發線，遇敵則避實擊虛，夜間襲擊落單的攻城分隊，奪回失地後立即退回山嶺；蒙軍退兵時又緊追其後，焚其草料與帳幕，使每次遠征都無法把補給帶回營中。城頭的技術分工也很清楚：弓弩與鐵箭負責遠射，矢石砲與投石機壓制密集隊形，火缽專門對付攀城的雲梯與攻城塔，壕溝、鹿砦、拒馬與陷坑則用來拖延接近。總結而言，蒙古靠的是速度、機動與攻城技術，高麗靠的是地勢、火力與耐心，兩者相持的結果，就是二十八年沒有勝負的長期消耗。
tacticsEn: The Mongols built their tactics on simultaneous pressure combined with siege one town at a time. They did not try to take the peninsula in a single stroke; they split the army into several columns that converged on a number of hill forts at once, so that the Goryeo garrison could never concentrate. At each town they first massed thousands of archers inside bow range to shoot the defenders off the walls, then hauled counterweight trebuchets into position and battered the place day after day, and only when a gap appeared did ladders, mines and battering rams go in together. They also knew how to starve: when a siege stalled they sent columns out to strip the surrounding country, burn the grain and cut the supply lines, so that the garrison exhausted what it had stored. In winter the northern pastures could no longer feed tens of thousands of war horses, and a distant campaign had to be broken off before the end of autumn, which meant a protracted war of attrition was bad for the besieger and good for the besieged. Goryeo used precisely that. The field army was kept out of the open, the main body was moved up into the strongholds around Guju, Chungju and Sangdang, grain was stored inside the walls, and the yeongbi of every circuit, organised in local associations, hunted the valleys and passes to cut the Mongol supply and foraging lines, avoided strong positions, struck weak ones, raided isolated siege detachments by night and fell back into the hills as soon as they had retaken the ground; when the Mongols withdrew, the militia closed in behind them, burning the fodder and the felt tents so that no column ever carried its supplies home. The division of labour on the walls was equally clear: bows and crossbows with iron arrows for range, stone-throwing engines against dense formations, fire pots against the ladders and the siege sheds, and ditches, abatis, chevaux-de-frise and pits used to slow the approach. In short, the Mongols relied on speed, mobility and siegecraft, while Goryeo relied on position, firepower and patience, and the result of that match was twenty-eight years of attrition without a decision.
data: 可用的數字主要來自韓系史籍與蒙古方面的記述，性質多是概數，不能當作精確統計。兵力方面，一二三一年第一次入軍的蒙軍，韓史多記為三萬餘騎，另有契丹、女真與漢軍步卒隨行；各道義兵與地方軍的總數亦以數萬計，兩邊在人力上並非懸殊，真正吃緊的是糧秣與牧場。一二五八年元方為東征準備的兵員以數萬計，同時用於攻宋者另有大軍，兩路相加是蒙古史上規模最大的部署之一。索取清單方面，蒙方第一次開列要求高麗繳出馬五百、駱駝五百，並交納大量絹帛，高麗只交出其中一部分，這成為第二次開戰的表面理由；一二五八年忽必烈開列的條件更重：金銀十萬、絹二十萬匹，另要高麗送太子入蒙。地理與時間上，自龜州到漢江上游的忠州陸路約二百餘里，鴨綠江渡口到首都約三百里；蒙軍自十月渡江，冬春攻城，到季夏便須籌劃退卻，因為此時北方牧場可供數萬匹戰馬啃食的草已不足，飢餓與疫病比刀箭更早結束遠征。圍城時間以數十日為常，忠州與龜州先後被圍，城頭被遠射與投石器覆蓋數十日不撤。戰役次數與跨度亦可確認：第一次入侵起於一二三一年十月，第二次在一二三六年至一二三八年，第三次計畫在一二五八年至一二五九年因蒙哥陣亡而流產；到一二五九年為止，這場戰爭已延續二十八年，在高麗國史上是前所未見的長期消耗。
dataEn: The usable figures come mainly from the Korean histories and from Mongol accounts, and most of them are round numbers rather than counts, so they cannot be treated as precise statistics. On strength, the first Mongol entry in 1231 is recorded in the Korean histories as upwards of thirty thousand horse, with Khitan, Jurchen and Chinese foot accompanying them; the militia and the provincial troops of the circuits were also numbered in tens of thousands, so the two sides were not badly mismatched in men, and what was tight was fodder and pasturage. For 1258 the force assembled for the eastern campaign numbered in the tens of thousands, with a separate great army against Song, and taken together the two columns were among the largest deployments in Mongol history. As for the lists of demands, the first Mongol submission asked Goryeo for five hundred horses, five hundred camels and a large quantity of silk; Goryeo delivered part of it, and that shortfall became the ostensible reason for the second outbreak. In 1258 the terms set by Kublai were heavier: one hundred thousand in gold and silver, two hundred thousand bolts of silk, and the crown prince sent to the Mongol court. On geography and timing, the land road from Guju to Chungju on the upper Han runs about two hundred li, and from the Yalu crossings to the capital roughly three hundred; the Mongols crossed in October, besieged through the winter and spring, and by high summer had to plan their withdrawal, because the northern grassland could no longer feed tens of thousands of war horses, and hunger and disease ended the expedition sooner than any blade. Sieges commonly ran for tens of days, with Chungju and Guju held under archery and stone-throwing fire for weeks on end. The shape of the war is also certain: the first invasion opened in October 1231, the second ran from 1236 to 1238, and the third, prepared in 1258 and 1259, collapsed when Möngke was killed. By 1259 the conflict had already run twenty-eight years, a length of fighting without precedent in Goryeo's own annals.
cause: 打起來的直接理由，是蒙古對高麗的索求從未被滿足。背景是十三世紀初蒙古在歐亞大陸的急遽擴張：西面滅西夏，南面攻金，遼東又有契丹首領耶律留哥起兵反蒙，高麗一度收容其部眾，一二一八年並依蒙古的要求處死留哥，這使高麗自此被捲入蒙古對東北亞的秩序裡。蒙古隨即要求高麗提供軍用物資、兵員與進貢，並要求高麗出兵助攻金國；高麗可以拖延，可以部分照辦，卻不肯派出主力出境，也不肯把太子送入蒙古營中作為人質。一二二九年蒙古使者入國索求，高麗只交出部分馬匹、駱駝與布帛，其餘以拖延與空言推搪，蒙古判定高麗違約，於是分兵越過鴨綠江，在一二三一年十月開戰。高麗在抵抗中不得不切斷與金的往來，一二三二年斷金交，半島南北同時成戰場；此後雙方反覆拉鋸，蒙古在一二三六年至一二三八年、一二五八年兩度重提人質與貢賦，並各自籌備大軍。高麗朝廷內部同時存在兩條路線：以崔㫕一系的通蒙周旋，與拒絕出使、拒絕納質的強硬路線。忽必烈最終選擇用兵，因為他判定高麗的抵抗只靠城守與拖延，把朝貢改為征服，在他看來是更省成本的辦法。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting was that the Mongol demands on Goryeo were never satisfied. The background was the Mongol expansion across Eurasia in the early thirteenth century: the empire destroyed the Western Xia in the west, opened war against Jin in the south, and in Liaodong the Khitan leader Yelü Liuge rose against the Mongols; Goryeo gave shelter to his followers and in 1218 executed him at the Mongol request, and from that point Goryeo was drawn into the Mongol order in Northeast Asia. The Mongols then demanded war materiel, troops and tribute, and required Goryeo to join them against Jin. Goryeo could stall, could comply in part, but would not commit its main army across the border, and would not send the crown prince to the Mongol camp as a hostage. In 1229 Mongol envoys arrived to make the levy; Goryeo delivered part of it, with horses, camels and silk handed over and the remainder met with promises and delays, and the Mongols judged the terms unfulfilled, so they crossed the Yalu in October 1231. Pressured by the resistance, Goryeo had to break off its relations with the Jin in 1232, and the peninsula fought on two fronts at once. From then the two sides grappled back and forth, the Mongols returning in 1236 to 1238 and again in 1258 to renew the hostage and tribute demands and to prepare armies. Inside the Goryeo court two lines ran in parallel: a line of accommodation and evasion associated with Choe Geup, and a line of refusal that would not send envoys and would not surrender the prince. Kublai finally chose force, judging that Goryeo's resistance rested only on walls and delay, and that converting tribute into conquest was the cheaper transaction.
impact: 這場戰爭留下的第一份遺產是半島的軍事傳統：以山城、弩砲、矢石砲與義兵結社構成的抵禦體系，在二十八年間被反覆實戰檢驗，成為高麗晚期最重要的骨架，後來朝鮮王朝立國時直接繼承的就是這一套做法，高麗的尚武風氣也延續到蒙古期。第二份遺產屬於技術：蒙古在攻宋與攻城過程中把漢地的工匠、火器與攻城術帶進半島，十三世紀三十年代以後，爆炸性的火器已出現在蒙古軍的攻城序列裡；至一二七〇年代，元軍在對高麗與南宋的戰役中使用外形如巨罐、內裝火藥與金屬碎片、中國稱為震天雷的爆炸物，高麗隨即仿製，朝鮮王朝的火砲技術正是從這一條線上分支出來。卡面的希臘火是這條技術譜系上更早、更純粹的源頭：它把以火阻止接近者的思路做到極致，而高麗在山頭上真正用來實現同一個功能的，是填猛火料的陶缽與可調射程的投石器。第三份遺產是政治格局：元於一二六五年在高麗境內設征東行省，以平壤為治所，一二七六年元軍攻入，國王恭愍王被俘，高麗自此淪為元的藩屬，按年進貢直到一三五六年才罷，此後半島與大陸的往來不再由高麗自主決定。第四份遺產是朝堂心態：崔㫕因通蒙被貶、鄭夢周等人因拒斥蒙古式文化而遭忌，說明這場戰爭留在士林的不是勝負，而是屈服換安寧是否可行的長期爭論，直到朝鮮王朝仍有人重提。
impactEn: The first inheritance of this war is military and Korean. A defence system built of hill fortresses, crossbows, stone-throwing engines and militia associations was tested repeatedly over twenty-eight years and became the framework that mattered most in late Goryeo, and the dynasty that followed at its founding inherited the same practices directly, while Goryeo's cult of the martial persisted through the Mongol period. The second inheritance is technical. The Mongols carried the craftsmen, the gunnery and the siegecraft of the Chinese plain into the peninsula during their campaigns against Song, and from the 1230s onward explosive devices already appeared in the Mongol siege train; by the 1270s the Yuan were using, against Goryeo and Song alike, a jar-shaped charge packed with gunpowder and metal fragments that the Chinese sources call the thunder-crash bomb, and Goryeo copied it, so that the artillery of the Joseon dynasty branched off from that same line. The card's Greek fire is the older and purer source of the same lineage: it carries the idea of denying approach with fire to its extreme, while the vessel that actually performed that function on a Korean rampart was the clay fire pot together with the adjustable stone-throwing engine. The third inheritance is political. In 1265 the Yuan set up a Branch Secretariat for the East inside Goryeo with its seat at Pyongyang; in 1276 the Yuan armies entered, the king Gongmin was taken prisoner, and Goryeo became a vassal paying annual tribute until 1356, after which intercourse between the peninsula and the continent was no longer decided on the peninsula. The fourth inheritance is a mood in the civil service: Choe Geup demoted for dealing with the Mongols, and men such as Jeong Mong-ju who resisted Mongol cultural pressure and suffered for it, mean that what the war left in the learned world was not a score but an argument, still being argued in the Joseon years, over whether a surrender bought peace.
result: 三次大規模入侵都沒有達成決定性的結果。第一次在一二三一年至一二三二年，蒙軍打到漢江上游的忠州與龜州，因攻城器械不足、糧秣接應不上、義兵在後方游擊而在年底退兵，高麗守住國土但耗盡儲藏；第二次在一二三六年至一二三八年重演同一格局，蒙古再度無法消滅高麗，於是議和並定下按年進貢的辦法；第三次在一二五八年至一二五九年，蒙古已把條件開到金銀十萬、絹二十萬匹與送太子，兵也調齊了，卻因八月蒙哥在釣魚城陣亡而全部取消。於是到一二五九年，高麗的處境是：國土尚存、王室未辱，但已從獨立的國降格為朝貢國，靠繳納與應酬維持關係；往後的變局不在戰場而在談判桌，一二六五年的征東行省、一二七六年的被俘與降元，都是前一階段的戰果加上一紙文書。裝備層面的結論也清楚：真正擋住蒙古攻城的是高麗的火缽、矢石砲與弩砲所構成的近城火力，加上敢於夜襲收復的義兵；而希臘火那種銅管噴射式燃燒器自九世紀以後已無實戰價值，它在本役的正確位置，是一張年代卡，用來標示以火阻退這一思路的源頭，實際把火用得最徹底的，是高麗的陶缽與後來的火藥爆炸物。
resultEn: None of the three great invasions produced a decision. The first, of 1231 to 1232, carried the Mongols as far as Chungju and Guju on the upper Han, and they withdrew before the end of the year because the siege train was inadequate, the supply line would not stretch, and the militia was harrying them from behind; Goryeo kept its territory but spent its stores. The second, of 1236 to 1238, repeated the pattern, the Mongols again failed to extinguish the kingdom, and peace was made with annual tribute arranged around 1241. The third was prepared in 1258 and 1259: the Mongols had pushed their terms up to one hundred thousand in gold and silver, two hundred thousand bolts of silk and the surrender of the crown prince, and the armies were mustered, but everything was cancelled when Möngke fell at Diaoyu Fortress in August. So by 1259 the position of Goryeo was this: the territory still existed and the royal house was not humiliated, but the kingdom had been demoted from an independent state to a tributary one, kept in place by payments and courtesies. What followed no longer happened on the battlefield but on the negotiating table: the Branch Secretariat of 1265, the capture and the submission of 1276, each a campaign result settled by a document. The equipment conclusion is equally plain. What actually held the Mongol assaults off was the close-range firepower built from Goryeo's fire pots, stone-throwing engines and crossbows, together with a militia willing to strike at night and take ground back; a copper-tube incendiary projector of the Greek fire type had no combat value after the ninth century, and its proper place in this war is as an age card marking the origin of the idea of holding the enemy off with fire, while the vessels that used fire most thoroughly were the Goryeo clay pot and the gunpowder bomb that came after it.
